name: Fruit
overview: Scripture portrays fruit as both a physical provision from God and a spiritual metaphor for the evidence of a transformed life. From the creation account where God grants every seed-bearing plant and fruit for food (Genesis 1:29), to Jesus’ teaching that abiding in Him is essential to bearing much fruit (John 15:5), fruit symbolizes the visible outcome of genuine faith and repentance (Matthew 3:8). The New Testament emphasizes that unfruitfulness leads to removal, while fruitful branches are pruned to yield even more (John 15:2), and bearing much fruit glorifies God and confirms discipleship (John 15:8).
